properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] Self-hosted application service spawns shell or SSH within seconds of inbound unauthenticated API write
properties.description:
Detects the recurring pattern across this fortnight's GHSA-Critical drop where a self-hosted Go/Node/Python/PHP service receives an unauthenticated (or low-privileged) POST/PATCH/PUT to an internal API path and within ~120s the same service process spawns a shell, ssh, or scripting interpreter child — the universal smoking-gun of in-process RCE primitives. This catches the chain in Nezha cron-RCE (CVE-2026-46716), Kopia SSH ProxyCommand injection (CVE-2026-45695), Algernon handler.lua escape (CVE-2026-45721), Fission router unauthenticated function invoke (CVE-2026-46614), Twig {% use %} PHP injection (CVE-2026-46633), FileBrowser Quantum path-traversal PATCH (GHSA-qqqm-5547-774x), Boxlite OCI symlink escape (CVE-2026-46703), YesWiki Bazar SQLi follow-on (CVE-2026-46670), zrok ProxyShare SSRF (CVE-2026-45568), and the @cap-js / guardrails-ai supply-chain stage-2 payloads (CVE-2026-46421, CVE-2026-45758). It spans Delivery (the HTTP request) into Exploit / Execute (the unexpected interpreter child). It fires when one of the listed service binaries is the immediate parent of /bin/sh, ssh, powershell, python, etc., correlated to an inbound listener connection in the prior 120s — it does NOT fire on the service's normal supervisor/health-check child processes, on container-runtime forks (containerd-shim, runc), or when the parent is a CI/dev image (`*-dev`, `*-test`).

Rationale: Every CVE in this fortnight's drop ultimately turns an unauthenticated/low-priv HTTP write into either a process spawn under the service or a shell-fork primitive — joining inbound listener traffic to an unexpected interpreter child under the same parent service binary, within a tight window, fires on the joint behaviour and stays useful as IOCs rotate.
properties.query:
// Multi-source: W3CIIS / Syslog (web layer) + Sysmon EID 1 / DeviceProcessEvents (process layer)
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowSec = 120;
let VulnerableServiceParents = dynamic([
  "nezha","nezha-dashboard","kopia","kopia.exe","kopia-ui","kopia-ui.exe",
  "algernon","filebrowser","fission-router","fission-bundle","boxlite",
  "zrok","yeswiki","php-fpm","php-fpm8.1","php-fpm8.2","php-fpm8.3",
  "httpd","apache2","node","node.exe","python","python3","python.exe"]);
let SuspiciousChildren = dynamic([
  "sh","bash","dash","zsh","ash","ssh","ssh.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe",
  "perl","ruby","curl","wget","nc","ncat","socat"]);
let VulnApiPaths = dynamic([
  "/api/v1/cron","/api/v1/repo/exists","/fission-function/",
  "/public/api/resources","BazaR","vue=formulaire","handler.lua"]);
let ChildSpawns = SecurityEvent
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
  | where EventID == 4688
  | extend ParentBase = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])),
           ChildBase  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,    "\\")[-1]))
  | where ParentBase in (VulnerableServiceParents)
  | where ChildBase  in (SuspiciousChildren)
  | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
  | extend ChildTime = TimeGenerated,
           VulnService = ParentBase,
           ChildBin = ChildBase,
           ChildCmd = CommandLine
  | project Computer, SubjectUserName, ChildTime, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd, NewProcessId;
let WebHits = union isfuzzy=true
  (W3CIISLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where csMethod in ("POST","PATCH","PUT")
    | where csUriStem has_any (VulnApiPaths)
    | extend Computer = sComputerName, InboundTime = TimeGenerated, RemoteSrc = cIP, ApiPath = csUriStem),
  (Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where SyslogMessage has_any (VulnApiPaths)
    | where SyslogMessage has_any ("POST ","PATCH ","PUT ")
    | extend Computer = HostName, InboundTime = TimeGenerated,
             RemoteSrc = extract(@"(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)", 1, SyslogMessage),
             ApiPath  = extract(@"\"(?:POST|PATCH|PUT)\s+(\S+)", 1, SyslogMessage))
  | project Computer, InboundTime, RemoteSrc, ApiPath;
ChildSpawns
| join kind=inner WebHits on Computer
| where InboundTime between (ChildTime - WindowSec * 1s .. ChildTime + 5s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ChildTime, InboundTime)
| summarize FirstInbound = min(InboundTime),
            DistinctSrcIps = dcount(RemoteSrc),
            SrcIps = make_set(RemoteSrc, 25),
            ApiPaths = make_set(ApiPath, 25)
          by Computer, SubjectUserName, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd, ChildTime, NewProcessId
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', ChildTime, FirstInbound)
| where DelaySec between (0 .. WindowSec)
| project ChildTime, Computer, SubjectUserName, VulnService, ChildBin, ChildCmd,
          DelaySec, ApiPaths, SrcIps, DistinctSrcIps, NewProcessId
| order by ChildTime desc
